title: Approving agent and Partner Fleet registrations
keywords: agent approval registration nric s t profile photo quiz partner fleet 7 days deletion access correction
body: Approve the same day if profile photo and quiz are complete, plus (manual applicants) an NRIC upload matching the NRIC field.
Only NRICs starting with S or T.
Message incomplete applicants; log what's needed and the due date in the profile log.
Still incomplete 7 days after the reminder: agents → request deletion on the Agent / Customer deletion chat (system auto-deletes at 30 days); Partner Fleet → delete the profile.
